teleconsulting

Get categories

Lists the teleconsultation categories available to search in.

GET/teleconsulting/getCategories

Authorizations

Authorizationbearer tokenRequired

The access token from POST /api/hiecm/gateway/v3/sessions.

Responses

200

Example values, scrubbed.

Get categories
curl --request GET \
  --url https://phrsbx.abdm.gov.in/teleconsulting/getCategories \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN_FROM_SESSIONS_CALL>'
